tools.name: ask_cynthia
tools.description:
Ask Cynthia a question. She answers ONLY from her verified
    knowledge, returning the verified answer verbatim labelled
    "Verified answer". If the question is not in her verified knowledge,
    she honestly abstains instead of guessing.

    Questions asked in Spanish are answered in Spanish fr

tools.name: ask_tutor
tools.description:
Ask Course Tutor Cynthia a course-content question about a topic
    covered in a Planet Leads Academy course. She answers ONLY from the
    verified lesson text of the 35 Academy courses (280 lessons),
    returning a verbatim excerpt from the matching lesson, cited as
    (Course name — Lesson N:

tools.name: cynthia_capabilities
tools.description:
Describe what Cynthia can do and the rules she follows
    (verified answers only, owner approval on risky actions,
    free-only building, subscription guard, and more).

tools.name: cynthia_question_digest
tools.description:
Owner digest of the questions asked on this server instance:
    how many questions matched each verified fact, the top questions
    with no verified answer yet (the content roadmap), and the most
    recent questions. The log holds only question text, matched fact
    id (or no-match), and a times

tools.name: cynthia_status
tools.description:
Report the Cynthia MCP server version, the number of verified
    facts in her knowledge store, and a health check.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "ask_cynthia" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
